The Purchase Order is attached as a PDF. Click Approve below to approve it — it is submitted at once and emailed to the supplier.

To reject it, open it in ERPNext and click the red Reject button (a reason is required): open {{ name }}.

If the Purchase Order is changed after this email, the confirmation page says so — use its View document link to see the latest version before you approve.
